title: 资源 API
implementation: GET /api/v1/{sites,feeds,feeds/{id},rules,jobs,jobs/{id},instances,commands/{id},dashboard,stats/downloaders/summary,stats/downloaders/timeseries} is wired to local read models with stable ordering and contract envelopes
GET /api/v1/sites and GET /api/v1/feeds read SQLite through rssservice; site responses embed feeds and expose poll_minutes, etag, last_modified, and updated_at
GET /api/v1/feeds/{id} returns a single feed with a resource ETag
POST /api/v1/sites and POST /api/v1/feeds persist local resources with authentication, CSRF, validation, Location, ETag, duplicate conflict, and foreign-key error mapping
PUT /api/v1/feeds/{id} updates allowed feed fields with If-Match and maps stale revisions to REVISION_CONFLICT
POST /api/v1/feeds/{id}/test executes only a read-only preview, persists an idempotent api_command, and exposes standard command state/result
GET/POST /api/v1/rules and GET/PUT /api/v1/rules/{id} use ruleservice with revision-guarded updates
POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/acknowledge-unknown covers the available local command closures without external downloader calls
ResponseValidator validates OpenAPI-shaped response payloads before writing them
DecodeJSON rejects trailing JSON values and handler paths preserve error envelopes
